premium.basis: 35% over the December 20 closing price of $23.36 (as stated in Rationale section)

value_inflection_events.event: Unidentified event causing stock price increase

leaked_early.details: No specific rumors naming DSM or a price were widely reported >1 month before announcement. General speculation and unusual options activity occurred only in the days immediately preceding the deal.

notes: Deal featured a competitive process with a PE bidder (Party B) and a strategic (DSM), with DSM winning due to higher closing certainty despite a lower initial offer; a top-up option was used to complete the short-form merger after the tender offer fell short of 90%.
